::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 12th [1863]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourn  
**Manuscript:** MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/ Yonge 1863/8
:::

My dear [Miss Smith](people/person_263.qmd)

I hope you will forgive me for leaving out a few bits of the [Thorne](other_books/otherbook_275.qmd) in order to squeeze the rest into this year. I enclose what was omitted in case you wish to restore it to the book as a whole though I think the present opinion is that the story wants abridging. I have put what is for the [M P](organizations/other_52.qmd) in one parcel, what is returned to you in another

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Envelope addressed to Miss Smith/ 8 Wellington Buildings/ Old Charlton/ SE and postmarked Winchester 13 November 1863 and London SE 14 November 1863.
